review_description: Sales and quoting process very professional and friendly. Matt from Nexus Electrix is extremely professional. Super friendly and very clean and tidy installer. Not the easiest install as I had to upgrade my power board, which involved extra work. Didn't phase him and the work was completed very promptly. He took the time to fully explain the system and the associated app. Extremely happy with the result and would recommend this installation to everyone.

The team at Nexus made the quoting process easy. They were available to discuss the details of the options provided & why the recommendation suited our house design & power demand. On the install day, the team turned up on time, completed the job & left the place tidy. 18 months on from the install, I’m incredibly happy with the system design & performance. It has met all my needs. I would use Nexus again if I decided to install batteries or a car charging system.

We had Matt and the team do a 10kw install for us 8 months ago. Matt was very professional to deal with throughout the entire process - with giving us multiple system options relative to our specified budget and energy use to the install itself being of top quality.The system Matt designed for us was better than we imagined, eliminating our powerbill.Highly recommend Matt and the team from nexus regarding anything Solar.
